Lines.Text: Commander, we've arrived at the Grasslands. The enemy has been spotted ahead.
Good. Set up defenses along the ridge. We can't let them break through.
Understood. I'll position our allies at the chokepoints.
The Grasslands are secured. Well fought, everyone.
We found some supplies the enemy left behind. Should we bring them back to the guild?
Absolutely. Every bit helps for the battles ahead.
